2. Set up the Newton’s Method iteration formula: xₙ₊₁ = xₙ – f(xₙ)/f ′(xₙ).
3. Start with the initial guess x₀ = –5.
4. Iteratively compute each xₙ using the Newton’s Method formula.
5. At each iteration, round the computed xₙ to four decimal places.
6. Compare the rounded value of the new iteration with the rounded value of the previous iteration.
7. Continue iterating until the rounded value converges (i.e., successive rounded values are identical).
8. The smallest n at which the convergence is observed (after performing xₙ₊₁ update) is the answer.
9. Verify the computations and rounding steps to ensure the correct iteration count.
